quest.title: Is "Intensity" Really the Key?
quest.description: Shall "intensity" vanquish the cold, or must some other step up to the plate?
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello there! Um...

dialogues.speaker: Loshts
dialogues.text: #Such overwhelming "intensity"! As expected of the legendary {NICKNAME} and Paimon! You've come all this way — don't tell me you're here to compete for the title of the "strongest in the Collective of Plenty"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Strongest in the Collective of Plenty"? Isn't this just the regular "Warrior's Challenge"? Look, there's a whole line of people waiting over there!

dialogues.speaker: Loshts
dialogues.text: Haha, they're nothing compared to you two. To claim the title of "strongest," you must defeat the current "strongest." Ordinary people don't even qualify for that.

dialogues.speaker: Loshts
dialogues.text: So, it is good that you are here... though your timing is less stellar, I fear. The master presently has no time to deal with worldly affairs, so a face-to-face meeting is not on the cards for now.

choices.text: Where is he, anyway?

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Oh? Are you planning to seek the master out for a battle? A bold move! In that case, I wouldn't mind sharing his whereabouts with you.

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Journey along training's rugged path, and you'll come across a mountainous region brimming with the "Waters of Intensity." There, perhaps, you'll find traces of the "strongest."

choices.text: Alright, then we'll wait for him to return.

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Indeed, indeed. "Intensity" draws "intensity," and the "strongest" will surely cross paths with the "strongest." So yes, waiting is certainly one option.

dialogues.speaker: Yoleehe
dialogues.text: Can someone lend a hand!? Someone just fainted!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh no, looks like the master's passed out! Let's go help too, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: It seems like the master only fainted from the heat and isn't seriously injured. With your help, Yoleehe carries the unconscious master away...\nLooks like the master's own ability to handle "intensity" still has some room for improvement...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Wait, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, don't go wandering off like that!

dialogues.speaker: Ma'chah
dialogues.text: So "cold"! This is so "cold"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Cold? What are you talking about... You're sitting in a hot spring, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Ma'chah
dialogues.text: No, no... This still isn't enough! If I'm to become the "strongest" — the "strongest" in the Collective of Plenty, no, in all Natlan — I can't settle for just this level of cold! The "intensity"... it's nowhere near enough!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh...? Why are you sitting back down again?

choices.text: It seems the "intensity" still isn't enough!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What even is this "intensity" you're talking about? Paimon doesn't understand a word you're saying!

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: #Oh, you must be the famous adventurers {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Wonderful! Now we're saved!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—What? Saved? What's going on...?

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: Alright, I'll spill the beans. According to the master himself, he's on a journey to become the "strongest." To that end, he's fully immersed himself in some sort of hot spring training!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, training? In a hot spring?

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: Yeah... I know it sounds crazy, but he got this idea from some martial arts book titled "The Book of Five Springs."

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: The book says that if you follow its teachings, you can eventually <color=#00E1FFFF>make cold water boil</color> just by using your own "intensity."

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: And that's not even the wildest part! The book's full of insane stories about martial arts legends — like one guy who punched straight through a mountain in one night, and another who could crush rocks into gemstones with his bare hands!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon never imagined there could be such incredible martial arts in the world! If you could learn them too, {NICKNAME}...

choices.text: Whoa, that's like something straight out of a novel.

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: Look, I get it — it sounds ridiculous. But this isn't just any random book. Our master found it in the collections owned by the Masters of the Night-Wind, so it's gotta be legit, right? And more importantly, he believes in it completely.

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: That's why he picked this specific hot spring — or rather, this "cold spring." His goal is to transform the freezing cold water into a true hot spring using nothing but sheer "intensity"!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... it's true! This water's ice-cold! But won't he get sick from staying in water like this for so long, no matter how strong he is?

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: Yeah, exactly! And even if he doesn't get sick, this can't go on forever. Our "Warrior's Challenge" has been put on hold for days, and everyone's waiting for him to come back!

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: But the master keeps saying that giving up halfway would mean he doesn't have enough "intensity." He's sworn that he won't leave until the water starts boiling.

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: The spring's manager has no idea why the water's gone cold in the first place. Honestly, if only we had some skilled adventurers around to help out... Look, I've even prepared a reward! All this, for anyone who can solve the problem.

choices.text: Maybe you should call someone from the People of the Springs to help out...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hey, let's not be so quick to turn him down. Let's check out how much he's offering first, at least!)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem, don't worry — we'll get this spring heated up again. Besides, we can't just let the master sit in freezing water until he gets sick. Helping people is what good adventurers do, right?

response.speaker: Yoleehe
response.text: Oh, thank you! I'll be counting on you, then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You just stay here. We'll have this sorted out in no time!

choices.text: Are you seriously trying to bribe me with that reward right now?
You don't actually believe that, do you?
It's probably because standing up makes him feel even colder...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon thinks so too. No wonder he's shaking like a leaf!

dialogues.speaker: Yoleehe
dialogues.text: Could it be... that everything written in "The Book of Five Springs" is true...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? A little Koholasaurus? Why is it here?
Ki'o-ki'o...! So you were here after all... If you guys hadn't come out when you did, I-I'd have...
What if you'd gotten hurt? Don't just run off like that again, okay? *sniff*...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H—Hey, cheer up! Look, your little saurian's fine, see? Super full of energy, too!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Rawr!
Ah, um... I'm okay now. Oh! I forgot to introduce myself. I'm Linaha, from the People of the Springs. I'm usually assigned to take care of the little Koholasaurs...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alone? That's pretty impressive!
N—Not really... If I were more like you, Ms. Paimon, they probably wouldn't have run off like that.
I was thinking that they might've all gone to play near the vents, and it turns out I was right...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the hot spring got cold because the little Koholasaurs had the phlogiston vents all blocked up, huh? No wonder the spring caretaker didn't notice anything!
Actually... there are still two more Koholasaurs I haven't found yet. I think they're probably hiding in the phlogiston vents too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Leave this to us! We'll find the other little Koholasaurs while we adjust the water temperature, don't you worry!
Really? Thank you! It's great to have Ms. Paimon around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, of course! You can always count on a legendary adventurer like the Great Paimon — this is a piece of cake!
Wow! Ms. Paimon, you're amazing! I want to be just like you someday!

choices.text: I agree. The Great Ms. Paimon is indeed amazing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Hey, can you not put Paimon on the spot like that in front of everyone? How about this — Paimon'll let you have the best dish tonight, okay?)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem! Anyway, let's get going!

choices.text: Alright then, I'll leave the next fight to you, oh Great Ms. Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Loshts
dialogues.text: How goes your journey to find the "strongest," oh warrior from faraway lands?

choices.text: Tell me where the "strongest" is located...

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: If you head up the mountain, you'll come across a region brimming with the "Waters of Intensity." There, perhaps, you'll find traces of the "strongest"...

choices.text: Still working on it...

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Ah yes, that would be lovely! Lovely!

dialogues.text: Great! You're all back! I was starting to think I might've really messed things up today!

dialogues.speaker: Ma'chah
dialogues.text: Huh? This is... so hot! The "intensity" is building up! Ahh! I did it! I really did it!

dialogues.speaker: Ma'chah
dialogues.text: Haha! What incredible "intensity"! Such unbelievable "intensity"!

dialogues.speaker: Ma'chah
dialogues.text: ...Aghhh!
Ki'o-ki'o, where are you...
#Oh hey, {NICKNAME}, it's you...

choices.text: Why do you look so down?

response.text: Actually... the hot spring water still feels colder than it used to. I really messed up this time. What am I gonna do when I go back...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't worry, just give it a bit more time.
Alright, got it...

choices.text: See you around.

response.text: #Um... take care on your way, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Well, we already agreed to help out, but where should we even start?

choices.text: How about giving our magical mystical phlogiston a try?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's never going to work! The area's way too big!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: *sigh* Isn't there a more realistic solution we can try?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, don't go wandering off like that!

choices.text: There's probably a lot of magma in the volcano nearby...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon gets it! We could have our little guy dig a tunnel, then use the volcanic magma to heat the hot spring, right? Not a bad idea...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #...Yeah, right! Get serious, would you? We could get people killed doing that! Worse, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} believed you for a second back there!

dialogues.speaker: Ma'chah
dialogues.text: Haha! So "cold"! This is so "cold"! But just watch — I'm about to crank the "intensity" right up! You'll boil alright, mark my words!
#It's you, {NICKNAME}! Hehe, long time no see! How have you been?

choices.text: Has something good happened?

response.text: Hehe, just between us — I discovered that the hot spring's water temperature is back to normal, which is great news for me — now my little Koholasaurs can play freely, and I won't have to worry anymore!
Next up, time to go have some fun! I'll enjoy the hot springs and the volcano to the fullest!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Enjoy yourself!
#Thanks, {NICKNAME}! You make sure to enjoy yourself too, alright?

choices.text: See you around.

response.text: Take care, and have a safe journey!

dialogues.speaker: Loshts
dialogues.text: Such incredible "intensity"... It's thrilling! Absolutely thrilling!

choices.text: Are you talking about me?

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Precisely, precisely! So, what do you say? Want to give the "Warrior's Challenge" a shot? Just sign up with the master. I've got high hopes for you!

choices.text: I'll head over soon!

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Lovely, lovely! Ah, I can hardly wait to see your legendary skills in action!

choices.text: Let me think about it...

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Ah, a shame, a shame indeed... I suppose I won't get to witness you in action after all.

choices.text: Sorry for disturbing you.

response.speaker: Loshts
response.text: Go well, go well.
